content:
The test image shows a corn stalk/leaf sheath with multiple dark brown-to-purple lesions, some with tan centers and dark margins. This is clearly a stem/sheath symptom.

Stem candidates: Anthracnose, Bacterial_Stalk_Rot, Charcoal_Stalk_Rot, Common_Smut, Diplodia_Stalk_Rot, Physoderma_Brown_Spot, Physoderma_Stalk_Rot, Purple_Leaf_Sheath, and others.

Top suspects based on KB: Purple_Leaf_Sheath (dark lesions, purple-brown-black on stalks/collars), Anthracnose (dark brown/purple margins), Physoderma_Brown_Spot (purplish-black oval spots on sheath/midrib).

Let me view references one per class.
Very strong visual match. Similar dark lesions with tan centers and dark margins on the leaf sheath. Let me check other candidates.
Anthracnose stalk rot looks very different - shiny black lesions on dried, dead stalks. Not a match. Let me check Physoderma_Brown_Spot.
Physoderma Brown Spot shows clusters of many small dark spots, quite different from the test image's larger discrete lesions with tan centers. Let me check more candidates.
Physoderma Stalk Rot shows many small dark spots/stippling pattern, not the larger discrete lesions in the test image. Let me check more candidates.
Diplodia Stalk Rot shows dried, dead stalks with breakage - completely different. Let me check Charcoal Stalk Rot and Bacterial Stalk Rot.
Charcoal Stalk Rot shows internal stalk shredding with sclerotia - completely different. Let me check Bacterial Stalk Rot.
Bacterial Stalk Rot shows widespread browning and collapse, not discrete lesions. Now let me use my last view to confirm with a second Purple_Leaf_Sheath reference.

Another strong match. This Purple_Leaf_Sheath reference shows the same pattern: dark brown/purple lesions with tan centers on the leaf sheath of a green, living corn plant. The lesion morphology, coloring, and location are very consistent with the test image.

The test image shows:
- Dark lesions on the leaf sheath/stalk area
- Lesions have tan/light centers with dark brown-to-purple margins
- Plant is green and actively growing
- Lesions are discrete, scattered across the sheath

Purple_Leaf_Sheath was by far the closest visual match across all 8 references viewed. All other stem diseases showed very different presentations (internal rot, dried stalks, small stippling, or widespread collapse).
